content: Khwāndamīr's entry says Khwāja Ṣāʾin al-Dīn ʿAlī Iṣfahānī “was renowned for his personal excellence and philanthropy”, lists his commentary on the Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam, the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ and a commentary on Ibn al-Fāriḍ's qasida, and gives his death in Herat as 14 Dhu'l-Ḥijja 83[5] (12 August 1432); MK adds in a note that the correct death year is supplied by Faṣīḥ Khwāfī's Mujmal al-Tavārīkh (the 5 is MK's bracketed correction).
